what: Paramount Skydance owns Paramount Pictures, CBS, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, Showtime and the streaming services Paramount+ and Pluto TV. Skydance Media merged into Paramount in 2025 and now runs it.
customers: Streaming subscribers, television advertisers, cinema audiences, and distributors licensing its content.
money: Paramount+ subscriptions and Pluto TV advertising
CBS network, cable channels and affiliate fees
moat: A film and television library going back a century, the CBS broadcast network, and sports rights including NFL games that still draw mass audiences.
risks: It reported a very large loss in the latest period after merger and impairment charges
Cable television revenue keeps shrinking as households cancel
Debt of about $16 billion against little cash
Streaming profitability is still being built
opportunities: Analysts see about 38% upside from current levels
New management has set out large cost reductions
Sports rights remain valuable to both broadcasters and streaming services
watch: Paramount+ subscriber growth and profitability, and cost savings delivered.
